messages:
Alex: Quick check — Support needs to pull LLM trace logs to debug privacy-filter false positives in prod. They only need a very narrow view (last 24h, traces for tenant 'alpha'), one-off, ~1h. Can we grant JIT console access instead of a long-lived role? Ticket: #SUP-4421
Maria: @Alex do we need access to raw prompt text? If yes we need a privacy-redaction waiver. If not, give masked view only. cc @Jamal
Jamal: For least-priv, propose a custom role `redwood.llm_trace_reader` with permissions like `logging.logEntries.list` scoped to the specific project/resource and `bigquery.jobs.get`/`bigquery.read` on the export dataset. Prefer ephemeral STS via our JIT flow rather than a permanent binding.
Alex: We only need metadata + masked prompt snippets (no raw). Good. How do folks request JIT in practice? Link?
Chris: Use zap-jit (internal). Example: `/zap grant --who support@acme.com --duration 1h --scope projects/redwood-prod/logs/llm_traces` — that creates an ephemeral SA and adds the binding for 1h, then it auto-removes. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Policy reminder — any access to traces that could contain PII requires a privacy review unless masking is enforced. Please attach the privacy review ticket. https://redwood.internal/policy/log-traces
Maria: Also include the redaction config in the request. Example snippet to attach to ticket:
```
redaction:
  mask_fields: [prompt, user_id]
  mask_type: token_replace
  preserve_hash: true
```
I'll add this to the SUP-4421 request.
Jamal: For reviewer convenience, sample gcloud binding to apply to the ephemeral SA (replace placeholders and keep resource narrow):
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="serviceAccount:ephemeral-support@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="projects/redwood-prod/roles/llmTraceReader"
```
I'll draft the custom role YAML and post it to the ticket after we confirm scope.
Alex: Thanks — please proceed. @Maria can you sign off on the privacy waiver? If yes, I'll mark the ticket ready for zap-jit.
Maria: Approved once masking is confirmed and config is attached. :white_check_mark: Attaching waiver to SUP-4421 now.
